scenarios.title: Tại Nhà Hàng (At the Restaurant)
scenarios.situation: Bạn muốn đặt bàn, gọi các món bít tết và tráng miệng, cũng như thanh toán hóa đơn bữa tối.
scenarios.firstMessage: Welcome to Bella Italia! Do you have a reservation for tonight, or would you like me to find you an available table?
starterSuggestions: I have a reservation for two under the name John.
Could we have a table near the window, please?
What do you recommend as today's special steak dish?

scenarios.title: Quầy Lễ Tân Khách Sạn (Hotel Check-In)
scenarios.situation: Bạn đã book phòng Deluxe trực tuyến, bây giờ muốn nhận phòng, hỏi về mật khẩu Wi-Fi, và giờ ăn sáng.
scenarios.firstMessage: Good afternoon! Welcome to the Grand Plaza Resort. How may I assist you with your booking today?
starterSuggestions: Hi, I would like to check in. I have a booking under Michael.
Is complimentary buffet breakfast included in my room package?
Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password and where the fitness center is?

scenarios.title: Thủ Tục Tìm Hành Lý Thất Lạc (At the Airport Lost & Found)
scenarios.situation: Hành lý ký gửi của bạn không xuất hiện trên băng chuyền sau chuyến bay quốc tế dài. Bạn muốn nhờ hỗ trợ.
scenarios.firstMessage: Hello, this is the Baggage Assistance Counter. Are you experiencing issues with your luggage today?
starterSuggestions: Yes, my suitcase did not come out on conveyor belt number four.
It is a medium-sized, black hardshell luggage with a red ribbon tied on top.
